subject: Re: Pricing follow-up — volume step-ups & blended rates for ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhang <emma.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up — volume step-ups & blended rates for ACME Health

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

Summary of need:
- ACME Health wants to expand LLM usage across two product routes: triage-assistant (short chat) and clinical-summarization (longer context).
- Target start: Q4 pilot, then phased rollout in H1.
- Primary constraints: predictable unit economics, ability to add new model routes, and a fallback policy for high-latency windows.

Expected token volumes (as discussed):
- Pilot month: ~25M tokens
- Phase 1 (months 2–6): 150–250M tokens/month
- Phase 2 (12 months): 600–900M tokens/month if both routes are live and usage scales.

Budget and unit economics goal you mentioned:
- Target blended cost: ~$40–$60 per 1M tokens (goal for $/1M after discounts and blended routing).
- Hard budget range for procurement is $15k–$50k/month for the pilot scaling window.

What we’ll provide for the next review:
1) A pricing proposal with volume step-ups and blended-rate examples across routes/models.
2) Options for reserved capacity vs. burstable dedicated pools and the estimated per-1M token unit cost for each.
3) A simple model showing when blended pricing reaches your target $/1M based on routing mix.

Attached: initial pricing proposal draft and the spreadsheet for the volumes you shared.

Next steps: would you be available for a 30-min pricing walk-through next week? If yes, propose two slots and we’ll lock one.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf, acme-expected-volumes.csv

From: Emma Zhang <emma.zhang@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up — volume step-ups & blended rates for ACME Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposal — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Volumes: the 150–250M range is our expected steady-state for the triage route once we hit product-market fit; clinical-summarization will be lower qps but much larger context (so more tokens per call). We’ll upload a slightly revised volume profile — see attached.

2) Target $/1M: $40–$60 is the number our finance director is comfortable presenting, but for procurement approval we need to show pathway to $40 within 6–9 months after pilot. If you can model blended routing (cheaper short-chat model + slightly more expensive long-context model) that shows how we hit $40, that will help our approval flow.

3) Contract cadence: we prefer annual commitments with quarterly true-ups. Also want to keep the option to add a third route (patient-education) mid-year.

I’m available Tue 6/30 10–11am PT or Wed 7/1 2–3pm PT for a pricing walk-through.

Best,
Emma
Director of Product | ACME Health
emma.zhang@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme-expected-volumes.csv

Hi team —

Attached is an updated pricing sketch and the blended-rate model (summary below). I kept it concise for procurement: one-pager + appendix. Uploading formal PDF in a minute.

Pricing highlights (examples):
- Pilot (month 1): 25M tokens — blended: $220 / 1M tokens (pilot fee + on-demand mix) — estimated monthly spend $5.5k.
- Phase 1 (150M/month): reserved pool option = $95 / 1M tokens; burstable/dedicated mix = $110 / 1M tokens.
- Phase 2 (600M/month): committed capacity pricing = $48 / 1M tokens; blended routing (70% short-chat at $40/1M, 30% long-context at $80/1M) => blended = $46/1M.

Path to $40/1M: if triage short-chat is served by a lower-cost quantized model at $35/1M and clinical long-context optimized to $70/1M, a 75/25 routing mix hits ~$41/1M. With small additional reserved commitment (5% uplift) we can model to $38/1M.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm which pricing option (reserved vs blended) you want in the formal proposal for ACME procurement.
- Emma/Tom: pick one of the two slots you suggested (Tue 6/30 10–11am PT preferred by them earlier).

I attached: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf (one-pager + appendix) and the blended model spreadsheet.

Thanks —
Vivek
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf, acme-blended-model.xlsx
